headword: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}
gloss: smooth talk; sweet words; lip service

definitions.gloss: smooth talk; glib talk; relying on words alone
definitions.explanation: Talking skillfully with words but without genuine substance or follow-through. Implies that someone's actions or character do not match their polished speech. Often used critically.

examples.japanese: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}でその{場|ば}を{乗|の}り{切|き}ろうとした。
examples.english: He tried to get through the situation with smooth talk alone.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}だから、{話|はなし}をうのみにしてはいけない。
examples.english: He's all smooth talk, so don't take what he says at face value.

examples.japanese: {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}で{人|ひと}を{動|うご}かすことに{長|た}けているが、{実行力|じっこうりょく}がない。
examples.english: He is skilled at moving people with clever words, but lacks the ability to follow through.

notes:
{口先|くちさき} (tip of the tongue; one's words) + {三寸|さんずん} (three sun, a short traditional measure — referring to the small space of the mouth). Together: suggesting talk with no real substance behind it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}でごまかす: to gloss over with smooth words
- {口先|くちさき}{三寸|さんずん}の{人間|にんげん}: a glib person, someone all talk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {口|くち}だけ: all talk — more colloquial and blunt
- {建前|たてまえ}: stated principle vs. actual intention — more specific to social pretense
